# Robat Das Orvi — AI Agent Engineering

> Robat Das Orvi writes about building, securing, and operating AI agents in production: tool use, authorization, reliability, state, evaluation, and cost controls. The site also publishes essays on software products, startups, psychology, philosophy, travel, and football.

## Author

Robat Das Orvi (Orvi) is a software builder and writer who has been coding since 2013. He co-created OneThread and AgencyHandy and builds developer tools including NoBurn, baar-core, ApiDiffGuard, and hatswap. His writing combines engineering experience with research and cited incident reports.

- [Author profile](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/profile): Background, selected work, and social profiles.
- [About Robat](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/about): His engineering focus, products, and approach to writing.
- [Contact](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/contact): Email hello@robatdasorvi.com.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/robatdasorvi-productdev/), [X](https://x.com/orvi_onethread), [GitHub](https://github.com/orvi2014).

## AI agent engineering: selected articles

- [Why LLM Agents Fail Silently in Production](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/how-llm-agents-fail-silently-in-production-and-how-i-learned-to-catch-it): Examines failures that report success and why production monitoring needs to detect them.
- [Least Privilege for AI Agents](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/least-privilege-for-ai-agents-scoping-tools-keys-and-filesystems-in-practice): Scoping agent tools, credentials, and filesystem access to limit the damage a mistaken action can cause.
- [Policy as Code for AI Agent Tool Authorization](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/policy-as-code-for-ai-agent-tool-calls-authorizing-actions-with-opa-or-cedar): How OPA or Cedar can enforce authorization decisions for agent tool calls.
- [MCP Tool Poisoning Attacks](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/mcp-tool-poisoning-malicious-tool-descriptions-and-silent-updates-to-trusted-servers): Malicious tool descriptions, changes after approval, and the limitations of one-time trust.
- [A2A Protocol Authentication Security](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/authenticating-agents-you-did-not-build-agent-cards-signed-requests-and-trust-in-the-a2a-protocol): Agent Cards, signed requests, and the difference between authentication and trust.
- [Durable Execution for AI Agents](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/durable-execution-for-multi-agent-runs-checkpointing-and-resuming-after-a-crash-with-temporal-or-a-plain-state-store): Compares Temporal with a plain state store and examines the risks of resuming work after failure.
- [AI Agent Rollback and the Saga Pattern](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/rolling-back-an-ai-agent-s-actions-compensating-transactions-and-the-saga-pattern-for-tool-calls): Why compensating transactions cannot always undo an agent's external actions.
- [Feature Flags for AI Agents](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/feature-flags-for-ai-agent-tools-disabling-one-capability-in-production-without-a-redeploy): Disabling a single agent tool in production and the failure modes of the flag itself.
- [Context Window Management for Long-Running AI Agents](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/context-window-management-in-long-running-agents-the-patterns-nobody-writes-about): Patterns for keeping relevant information available across long agent runs.
- [LLM Function Calling in Production](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/chapters/ai-agents/tool-use-in-llms-what-it-actually-means-for-production-systems): Tool-use reliability, validation, and production failure modes.

## Products and projects

- [NoBurn](https://noburn.dev): Financial guardrails for LLM API calls.
- [baar-core](https://baar.robatdasorvi.com): Pre-flight budget enforcement for LLM agents.
- [ApiDiffGuard](https://apidiffguard.com): Detects breaking API response changes.
- [hatswap](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/hatswap): Open-source CLI for managing multiple Claude Code accounts.
- [OneThread](https://www.onethreadapp.com): Project management software for teams.
- [AgencyHandy](https://agencyhandy.com): Client workflow software for agencies.
- [All projects](https://www.robatdasorvi.com/store).
